muCrab — Two claws, two panes.

Usage: mucrab [LEFT_PATH [RIGHT_PATH]]
mucrab [--help | --version]

Opens local folders or ZIP paths in the native two-pane browser.
Name ordering uses en-US; Show hidden files applies to both panes.
F5 copies, F6 moves, F2 renames; Batch rename reviews masks and counters.
